name: shine-border
blurb: Light sweeps around the border in a continuous loop.
description: An absolutely-positioned overlay that renders a radial gradient which moves around the border of its parent container. Uses CSS animation with prefers-reduced-motion support.
use_when: A card or section border that needs subtle movement and polish without demanding attention.
avoid_when: When you need the border to be interactive or visible on very small elements.
a11y: Visual overlay only with pointer-events-none. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.
